answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 36615 Country: India Title: Can we use the money we got from interest from our bank account to pay income tax Question: Can we use the money we got from interest from our bank account to pay income tax? Answer ID: 36615 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 290/290/M=1433) It is allowable. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
